## Files

| File | Produced by |
|---|---|
| `messages/plaintext.txt` | `printf`, LF line endings |
| `messages/binary.bin` | `printf`, contains bytes that are not valid UTF-8 |
| `ciphertexts/*` | `gpg --encrypt` / `gpg --symmetric` |
| `signatures/*` | `gpg --detach-sign` / `--clearsign` / `--sign` |

## Commands

```
# keys
gpg --batch --pinentry-mode loopback --passphrase '<passphrase>' --quick-generate-key '<uid>' rsa2048 sign,encrypt never
gpg --batch --pinentry-mode loopback --passphrase '<passphrase>' --quick-generate-key '<uid>' ed25519 sign never
gpg --batch --pinentry-mode loopback --passphrase '<passphrase>' --quick-add-key <fpr> cv25519 encrypt never
gpg --batch --armor --export <fpr> > keys/<name>-public.asc
gpg --batch --pinentry-mode loopback --passphrase <passphrase> --armor --export-secret-keys <fpr> > keys/<name>-private.asc

# ciphertexts
gpg --batch --armor --encrypt --recipient <fpr> messages/plaintext.txt
gpg --batch --encrypt --recipient <fpr> messages/plaintext.txt
gpg --batch --armor --throw-keyids --encrypt --recipient <fpr> messages/plaintext.txt
gpg --batch --armor --textmode --encrypt --recipient <fpr> messages/plaintext.txt
gpg --batch --armor --compress-algo zip --encrypt --recipient <fpr> messages/plaintext.txt
gpg --batch --armor --pinentry-mode loopback --passphrase 'shared-fixture-password' --symmetric messages/plaintext.txt

# signatures
gpg --batch --armor --detach-sign messages/plaintext.txt
gpg --batch --detach-sign messages/plaintext.txt
gpg --batch --armor --clearsign messages/plaintext.txt
gpg --batch --armor --sign messages/plaintext.txt
```

## Smoke lane

`smoke/credentials.json` is an `n8n import:credentials` payload holding the
unprotected RSA private key.
